title: standardCodeModules
responsibility: Declare twelve internal Code capabilities and their existing generators and navigation destinations.

outputs.name: standardCodeModules
outputs.description: This array contains the twelve version 1.0.0 internal module definitions, each included by default with one resource. It supplies the standard Code catalog before project installation; definitions have empty setup and dependency declarations and use per-kind generation rules.
